2607.18909.title: Enhancing Transformer-based Routing by Encoding Distance via Relative Positional Encoding
2607.18909.paper_summary: This paper explores Relative Positional Encoding (RPE) as an additive bias in Transformer architectures to solve the Team Orienteering Problem. By embedding in the attention mechanism pairwise spatial relationships among nodes of the graph that represents the routing problem, the transformer encoder can compute a richer spatial-aware graph embedding that allows the decoder to estimate better routes. Experimental results involving instances up to 100 nodes demonstrate consistent improvements in collected rewards and optimality gaps over vanilla Transformer architectures used by other state-of-the-art works. These findings highlight that explicit relational modeling significantly enhances scalability and generalization for complex combinatorial optimization.
2607.18909.paper_summary_zh: 這篇論文探討了相對位置編碼（RPE）作為Transformer架構中的一種加性偏置，以解決團隊定向問題。<lb/>通過在注意力機制中嵌入表示路由問題的圖中節點之間的成對空間關係，Transformer編碼器可以計算出更豐富的空間感知圖嵌入，這使得解碼器能夠更好地估計路徑。<lb/>涉及最多100個節點的實驗結果顯示，在收集的獎勵和最優性差距上，相較於其他最先進工作所使用的普通Transformer架構，取得了一致的改進。<lb/>這些發現強調了明確的關係建模顯著增強了複雜組合優化的可擴展性和泛化能力。
